justifications.unit: Measured 41.9%: the unit tests cover the constructor, the cancellation guards, ExtendAsync and the failed-release path of the lock handle (a closed connection makes the release command fail, and the test asserts the Warning with the exception type only); the acquire, release and IsLocked paths call sp_getapplock on a connection the provider creates itself and need a real SQL Server.
justifications.guard: Measured 6.3%: the guard tests assert the ArgumentNullException of the constructor and of each public method; every other line runs only past those guards and belongs to the unit and integration flags.
justifications.integration: The acquire, release and IsLocked paths run sp_getapplock and need a real SQL Server; the integration tests exercise them in Docker and were not measured in this change, so the target keeps the package value of 15.
